_about: T-210 batch 1 (DRAFT, for the user's approval): the six starter lines of Johto and Hoenn, named by their own type's register (vision.md 2.9). Each: vanilla species, our name, INDEX category, the CONTENT entry (what it does), the CONTEXT entry (what follows).

daemons.name: PRIMER
content: It will only eat what it has eaten
before, a little harder each time.
It has never once been surprised.
context: It learns best when nothing is at
stake. Somebody always has to decide
what counts as easy.

daemons.name: SYLLABUS
content: It lays its meals out in a row and
eats them in that order, every time.
It will not skip ahead.
context: The order was chosen for it. It has
never asked who chose it, or what
they left until last.

daemons.name: CURRICULUM
content: It can digest anything now, because
it was given everything in the right
order. Its scent calms others.
context: Those near it feel they could learn
anything. They forget how much was
decided for them first.

daemons.name: TEPID
content: It runs a little warm. Its choices
wander slightly, which is how it
finds the ones nobody tried.
context: It never says the same thing twice.
Some call that unreliable. Some call
it the only honest one.

daemons.name: SEETHE
content: Turned up, it tries everything at
once. The flames on its back are its
answers, all of them still moving.
context: It is not angry. It is undecided,
very quickly, in every direction.

daemons.name: HEATDEATH
content: At full heat every outcome becomes
equally likely. Nothing it does is
wrong. Nothing is right either.
context: Near it, every place feels the same
as every other. It is very calm.
That is what is frightening.

daemons.name: LEARNRATE
content: It bites at anything and adjusts by
how hard it bit. Too eager, it
overshoots. Too shy, it starves.
context: It is still learning how much to
change each time it is wrong.
So is everyone who keeps one.

daemons.name: MOMENTUM
content: Once it is moving downhill it keeps
going, rolling over the small dips
that would have stopped it.
context: It does not stop to check whether
the slope is still the right one.
That is its strength.

daemons.name: STEEPEST
content: It always takes the sharpest way
down, and fast. It has never found
the lowest valley, only the nearest.
context: It is very sure it has arrived.
It has. It is just not where anyone
wanted it to be.

daemons.name: STUMP
content: It can ask only one question: above
or below? It is right a little more
often than a guess would be.
context: Alone it is barely better than
chance. Nobody has told it yet that
alone is not how it will be used.

daemons.name: BOOSTING
content: It studies its own mistakes and
sends the next one in to fix them.
Its leaves grow where it was wrong.
context: Each one that follows is shaped by
the last one's failures. None of
them is ever told it was enough.

daemons.name: CANOPY
content: Hundreds of small questions, added
up, make one answer that is hard to
fool. It guards the whole wood.
context: No tree in it knows what the forest
decided. It decided anyway.

daemons.name: COINFLIP
content: It decides by chance and says so.
Half the time it is right. It never
pretends to know which half.
context: People trust it more than they
trust anyone who claims to be sure.

daemons.name: MONTECARLO
content: It guesses a thousand times and
counts what it found. The answer is
almost always close. Almost.
context: It is quick and usually right, and
it cannot tell you when it is not.

daemons.name: LASVEGAS
content: It rolls the dice until the answer
is proven, then stops. It is never
wrong. It is sometimes very late.
context: Ask it something and wait. It will
not hand you a guess dressed as an
answer. Some cannot bear the wait.

daemons.name: RUNOFF
content: Water finds its way off it, always
downhill, carrying a little of the
ground with it each time.
context: It does not notice what it takes.
The hillside does.

daemons.name: ALLUVIUM
content: What the water carried, it lays
down in layers. Every flood it has
seen is in it, oldest at the bottom.
context: Dig into it and you find every
change it was ever made to make,
in order.

daemons.name: DELTA
content: Where it meets the sea it spreads
into a hundred small corrections,
each one the size of its last miss.
context: It moves by the difference between
where it is and where it was told
to be. It never arrives. It gets close.
